name: sistec-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace of the Sistec team

plugins.name: hello-sistec
plugins.description: Example plugin: skill, agent and hook to get started quickly

plugins.name: technical-writer
plugins.description: Technical documentation: technical-writer drafts a new Italian HMI operator manual (Markdown → HTML) from the control narratives; maintain-manual maintains an existing Word manual (.docx) (revisions, copy-edit, audit vs code, structure, comments) via python-docx; spec-document drafts specification/design documents as a single self-contained HTML in the Sistec engineering-sheet style

plugins.name: hmi-developer
plugins.description: Development assistant for the Sistec.HMI solution (.NET 8 / WinForms): TDD cycle, project hooks, WinForms DPI/anchor bug fixes, i18n SQL generation (MissingTranslations.csv → language_spv), feature reconciliation between solutions and csharp-doc-comments for C# XML doc comments (Microsoft/StyleCop). Persona and C#/HMI rules live in the project (CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules/), not in the plugin

plugins.name: git-release
plugins.description: Multi-repo release tools: /git-release:gitize (diff → Conventional-Commits), /git-release:git-split-commits (staged → multiple commits), /git-release:git-amend-commits (staged → folded into existing commits), /git-release:versionize (release notes from built DLLs + git) and /git-release:package-release (zip packaging + repeat). No production deploy: the scope stops at the zip

plugins.name: log-forensics
plugins.description: Read-only forensic analysis of PLC/HMI logs and captures: /log-forensics:analyze-crash (correlated timeline + root cause) and /log-forensics:track-timing (timing and event-chain consistency of a Fael/HMI log, with the cells' DB day tables)

plugins.name: device-spy
plugins.description: Read-only inspectors: /device-spy:codesys-spy (encrypted CODESYS → PLCopen XML + POU source + analysis), /device-spy:ubiquity-spy (config snapshot of a Ubiquiti router) and /device-spy:network-probe (local host network config + health → link-flap / IP conflict / driver diagnosis). Where needed, passwords via env/STDIN, never on disk

plugins.name: blender-ply
plugins.description: CAD PLY models in Blender via the MCP bridge: /blender-ply:view-ply (colours + clip + view + zoom after the import), /blender-ply:center-blender (centres the view without rotating it), /blender-ply:center-ply (origin on the selected vertex, valid in the exported PLY), /blender-ply:snapshot-ply (PNG on a white background) and /blender-ply:ply-colors (per-vertex colour restore)
